Vacancy \#: 7703
  

Unit: Climate Change and Energy Transition
  

Organisation: International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)
  

Location: European Regional Office, Bonn, Germany
  

Reporting to: Communications Officer
  

Work percentage: 100%
  

Grade: I
  

Expected start date: 01 November 2026
  

Type of contract: Fixed\-term (up to 6 months with possibility of renewal)
  

Closing date: 04 October 2026
  

  

BACKGROUND
IUCN is a membership Union composed of both government and civil society organisations. It harnesses the experience, resources and reach of its more than 1,400 Member organisations and the input of more than 17,000 experts. This diversity and vast expertise makes IUCN the global authority on the status of the natural world and the measures needed to safeguard it.  

  

IUCN’s vision is a just world that values and conserves nature. IUCN’s mission is to influence, encourage and assist societies throughout the world to conserve the integrity and diversity of nature and to ensure that any use of natural resources is equitable and ecologically sustainable.  

  

IUCN helps the world find pragmatic solutions to our most pressing environment and development challenges. We work on biodiversity, climate change, energy, human livelihoods and greening the world economy by supporting scientific research, managing field projects all over the world, and bringing governments, NGOs, the UN and companies together to develop policy, laws and best practice.  

  

The Climate Change and Energy Transition Team (CCETT) leads IUCN’s global thematic work on climate change, both to limit the future impact of climate change and to help vulnerable communities and ecosystems adapt to unavoidable climate impacts. The team engages on climate issues from multiple perspectives; from assessing the risks that climate change poses to communities and biodiversity to advocating for improved climate policy and practice; advancing Nature\-based Solutions for both mitigation and adaptation centred on improved conservation, management, and restoration of natural ecosystems; and guiding climate investments to avoid maladaptation and ancillary negative impacts on biodiversity and nature\-dependent livelihoods.  

  

CCETT is seeking a highly motivated intern for a six\-month mandatory internship. Interns at IUCN are provided with a quality experience that combines meaningful work and learning opportunities, enabling them to gain practical skills in their chosen field of study. This role provides an unparalleled opportunity to delve into the world of Nature\-based Solutions, the energy transition and climate action, gaining first\-hand experience in influential conservation action and policy\-making initiatives. The internship will be full\-time, based out of the IUCN European Regional Office in Bonn, Germany, and for at least six months with the possibility of extension.


JOB DESCRIPTION
To be eligible for this internship, candidates must:  

  

a) Have secured the right to live and work in Germany for the entire duration of the internship. IUCN will not provide assistance with visa or work permit applications, nor will it alter applicants' visa status.  

b) Be enrolled in a university or equivalent tertiary institution:  

* Undergraduate students should have completed at least one year of full\-time study.
* Graduate students should be in the process of completing their degrees.
* Be enrolled in an academic program relevant to the duties and responsibilities outlined in the Terms of Reference.

  

Remuneration:  

This is a non\-paid internship. Interns or their sponsoring institutions are responsible for the costs and arrangements related to travel, visas, accommodation, and living expenses.  

  

Additional Information:  

Students are encouraged to apply to their university for an Erasmus\+ Internship grant: https://erasmusintern.org/content/scholarships.  

  

OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY:  

  

Under the supervision of the CCET Programme Officer and reporting to the CCET Communications Manager, the Intern will support the implementation of the team’s communications strategy, including the development of high\-quality communications products, social media management, and the coordination, promotion, and delivery of meetings, webinars, seminars, conferences, and other events.  

  

SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  

* Contribute to the drafting and design of various communications materials, including articles, newsletters, social media content, briefs and PowerPoint presentations;
* Support the maintenance of LinkedIn pages and websites and help ensure consistency across digital platforms;
* Assist in monitoring media coverage, social media performance and analytics to inform communications approaches;
* Support the production of publications and promotional materials highlighting CCETT’s portfolio and activities;
* Assist in coordinating and organizing meetings, webinars, seminars, conferences and other events, including supporting invitations, participant coordination, scheduling, preparation of agendas and materials, and logistical and technical arrangements;
* Support the set\-up and smooth running of virtual, hybrid and in\-person meetings and events, including coordinating meeting links and platforms, presentation materials, participant lists and other practical arrangements as required;
* Attend relevant meetings, webinars, seminars, conferences and events; take clear and concise notes; document key discussions, decisions and action points; and prepare meeting minutes, summaries and outcome reports;
* Support communications related to the team’s major and minor events, including event promotion, preparation of communications materials, coverage during events, and dissemination of key messages and outcomes;
* Provide general coordination and administrative support to communications\-related activities, meetings and events as required.

  

* The above job description contains the main duties and responsibilities for this position. However, in an organisation such as IUCN, staff members are expected to show flexibility in their approach to work and be willing to undertake other tasks that are reasonably allocated to them, but which are not part of their regular job description. Where any task becomes a regular part of an employee's responsibilities, the job description will be changed in consultation with the employee and the Human Resources Management Group.
REQUIREMENTS
 - Studying towards a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in environmental science, sustainable development, natural sciences, political science, international relations, international development, public policy, or communications;
  

  

- Strong interest in biodiversity conservation, climate change, and/or community livelihoods and wellbeing, with clear affinity for IUCN’s vision and mission;
  

  

- Understanding of nature\-based solutions and the energy transition is an advantage but not required;
  

  

- Strong knowledge of design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe) to support the development of communication assets including videos.
  

  

- Complete fluency in English, with excellent writing and editing skills. Ability to draft clear and engaging content for different audiences and formats, including social media, newsletters, articles, presentations, and briefs. Familiarity with LinkedIn, website content management, and basic communication analytics is an asset.
  

  

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and general IT literacy;
  

  

- Strong analytical, organisational, multitasking, and problem\-solving skills;
  

  

- Detail\-oriented, with a focus on producing high\-quality outputs under tight deadlines;
  

  

- Ability to work independently while managing multiple tasks;
  

  

- Ability to meet tight deadlines without compromising the quality of outputs;
  

  

- Highly motivated to learn, develop new skills, and contribute ideas;
  

  

- Team player with enthusiasm for working in an international environment
  

  

- Authorisation to work in the Germany (no visa sponsorship available for this position).

  



APPLICATIONS
Applicants are requested to apply online through the HR Management System, by opening the vacancy announcement and pressing the "Apply" button.


Applicants will be asked to create an account and submit their profile information. Applications will not be accepted after the closing date. The vacancy closes at midnight, Swiss time (GMT\+1 / GMT\+2 during Daylight Saving Time, DST). Please note that only selected applicants will be personally contacted for interviews.


Other job opportunities are published in the IUCN website: https://www.iucn.org/involved/jobs/


***About IUCN***  

  

*IUCN is a membership Union uniquely composed of both government and civil society organisations. It provides public, private and non\-governmental organisations with the knowledge and tools that enable human progress, economic development and nature conservation to take place together.*  

  

*Created in 1948, IUCN is now the world’s largest and most diverse environmental network, harnessing the knowledge, resources and reach of more than 1,400 Member organisations and around 16,000 experts. It is a leading provider of conservation data, assessments and analysis. Its broad membership enables IUCN to fill the role of incubator and trusted repository of best practices, tools and international standards.*  

  

*IUCN provides a neutral space in which diverse stakeholders including governments, NGOs, scientists, businesses, local communities, indigenous peoples organisations and others can work together to forge and implement solutions to environmental challenges and achieve sustainable development.*  

  

*Working with many partners and supporters, IUCN implements a large and diverse portfolio of conservation projects worldwide. Combining the latest science with the traditional knowledge of local communities, these projects work to reverse habitat loss, restore ecosystems and improve people’s well\-being.*

Wir suchen eine:n Social Media Manager:in (m/w/d) mit 30 bis 32 Wochenstunden für die Kanäle unserer Kunden und unsere eigenen Auftritte. Von der Idee in der Redaktionssitzung über Gestaltung und Text bis zur Ausspielung liegt der Content in einer Hand – deiner. **WIR SIND SCHWIND'**

Wir sind eine inhabergeführte Kreativagentur mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden in der Bonner Südstadt. Seit 1990 entwickeln wir Kommunikationslösungen für Unternehmen und öffentliche Auftraggeber in den Bereichen Markenkommunikation, Employer Branding und digitale Kommunikation. KI ist bei uns kein Zukunftsthema, sondern tägliches Werkzeug. Für Text, Bildideen, Konzeption und Reporting haben wir Lösungen im Einsatz, die dir Routine abnehmen und Zeit für das Inhaltliche lassen.

* Eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit 30 bis 32 Wochenstunden je nach Arbeitszeitmodell. Das Gehalt liegt, abhängig von Berufserfahrung und Stundenzahl, bei ca. 30\.000 bis 34\.000 € p. a.

* Moderne Apple\-Hardware, individuelle Weiterbildung, viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
* Jobticket und Jobrad\-Leasing möglich, betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss, Corporate Benefits und regelmäßige Teamevents

**DEINE AUFGABEN**

* Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit den Kunden die Redaktionsplanung über alle Accounts hinweg und hältst die Deadlines fest im Blick
* Das laufende Tagesgeschäft produzierst du selbst: Grafiken, Reels und Stories auf Basis der Master\-Vorlagen unseres Kreations\-Teams, KI\-gestützt und mit den gängigen Tools
* Für größere Produktionen oder aufwendige Sonderformate stimmst du das Briefing mit dem Kunden ab und setzt es gemeinsam mit unserem Kreativteam um
* Du textest Captions, Anzeigentexte und Kampagnenbotschaften auf Basis der hinterlegten Kunden\-Guidelines
* Du spielst die Inhalte über Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und TikTok aus und weißt, welches Format auf welchem Kanal trägt
* Du prüfst die weitgehend automatisierten Reportings, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest selbstständig Handlungsempfehlungen ab

* Du bist in internen wie externen Jour Fixen die fachliche Stimme für Social Media und stehst als Ansprechperson für Rückfragen aus dem Team zur Verfügung

**DAS BRINGST DU MIT**

* Du brauchst dafür keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Grafikdesign. Entscheidend ist, dass du es kannst und ein sehr gutes Gespür dafür hast, wann ein Post sitzt
* Du kannst ein sauberes internes Briefing schreiben: Was der Kunde vereinbart hat, so weitergeben, dass Fotograf/Videograf und Kreation ohne Rückfragen damit arbeiten können

**SCHÖN, ABER KEIN MUSS**

* Erfahrung im Community Management

EDITORIAL CONTENT
  

INTERNSHIP (F/M/X)
  

The International Paralympic Committee (IPC) offers a full\-time Editorial Content
  

Internship (f/m/x) in an international and multicultural team at the IPC
  

Headquarters in Bonn, Germany, for a duration of 6 months, starting
  

approximately in August 2026\.


ABOUT THE IPC
  

At the IPC, we work as one team, aligned and focused on fulfilling our vision and
  

mission.


The IPC’s vision is for an inclusive world through Para sport. We believe that
  

Change Starts With Sport, and that the work of the Paralympic Movement is a
  

catalyst for driving social inclusion and advancing the UN Convention on the
  

Rights of Persons with Disabilities and the UN’s 17 Sustainable Development Goals.


The IPC, a purpose\-driven non\-profit association, is the global governing body of
  

the Paralympic Movement. We oversee the delivery of the Paralympic Games and
  

Paralympic Winter Games and serve as International Federation for five Para
  

sports. We enjoy a positive working relationship with the IPC Governing Board,
  

members of which are democratically elected every four years by the IPC General
  

Assembly. Since 1989, we have been creating change through sport with the
  

Paralympic Games and Paralympic athletes at our core.


The IPC seeks to use the influential global position of the Paralympic Movement
  

and the growing profile of Para athletes to challenge the stigma attached to
  

disability and empower social transformation.


INTERNSHIP
  

The Editorial Content Intern (f/m/x) will support the Editorial Content Manager in
  

producing content for the International Paralympic Committee website, focusing
  

on competitions and the performances of leading Para athletes. Due to the





character of the mandatory internship, please be aware that the internship can
  

only be offered unpaid.


CORE AREAS


* Under the guidance of the Editorial Content Manager, produce stories for

the official Paralympic website that spotlight leading Para athletes and
  

their performances, as well as initiatives that are being implemented to
  

develop the Paralympic Movement.
* Interview athletes, coaches and officials from across the Paralympic

Movement to highlight their achievements, involvement or development in
  

Para sport.
* Upload stories and multimedia content to the IPC website, including

sourcing relevant images, artwork and meta texts.
* Contribute to team meetings by proposing new ideas and conducting

research on athletes and competitions.
* Support with content maintenance and SEO tasks to improve

discoverability and performance of the IPC website.
CORE REQUIREMENTS


* Currently enrolled in a university degree or equivalent qualification in

journalism, communications, digital media or a relevant field.
* Passion for writing about sports and sharing the stories of athletes.
* Excellent verbal and written command of English, with strong attention to

detail. Additional languages are an asset.
  

* Curious and eager to learn about the Paralympic Movement, with the ability
to think outside the box.
  

* Passion for the IPC’s vision, mission and values.
* Interest in experiencing an intercultural work environment.
* Strong organisational, communication and interpersonal skills.
* An open, creative and innovative mindset.
* The internship must be a mandatory part of one’s studies.
  

Do you want to apply?
  

  

If you are interested and provide a good match with our requirements, please send
  

your CV and cover letter in English and in PDF to ContentJobs@paralympic.org.  






For this position, we will review applications and interview candidates on a rolling
  

basis.
  

  

The IPC is an equal opportunity employer, and we especially encourage individuals
  

with a disability and members of minority groups to apply; we support the
  

relocation process and provide transitional accessible accommodation. For
  

further information on the IPC, please contact us or visit our career website at
  

www.paralympic.org/careers.  

  



We look forward to your application!

**Job Summary**
 Kennametal continues to expand its Defence and Specialty Applications portfolio, and we are seeking a highly motivated Key Account Manager – Defence to join our team at Kennametal.
   

  

 This role has primary responsibility for strategic key account management, business development, and sales execution across the European region within the defence and protection markets, including applications such ammunition, fragmentation solutions, and protective systems.
   

  

 The Key Account Manager will work closely with procurement organizations, system integrators, OEMs, and government suppliers to develop long\-term partnerships and drive sustainable business growth.
   

  

 Working under the direction of the Head of Defence EMEA, the successful candidate will serve as a commercial interface for Kennametal Defence products within Europe, supporting regional growth strategies, customer engagement, commercial negotiations, and enterprise account initiatives.
   

  

 We are a growing team, with a strong emphasis on collaboration and communication, we value boldness, ownership and agility. We have a positive team culture of trust and growth. If you are looking for a challenge in an extremely dynamic and exciting industry, then this is the role for you.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
**Sales \& Key Account Management**
* Manage and develop strategic defence accounts across Europe.
* Build and maintain long\-term customer relationships with decision\-makers at multiple organizational levels.
* Develop and execute account strategies, sales plans, and budgets to achieve regional growth objectives.
* Lead customer meetings, commercial negotiations, and contract discussions.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer inquiries, action items, and commercial requirements.


**Business Development \& Market Growth**
* Identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
* Drive customer acquisition and demand creation across Kennametal's Defence portfolio.
* Develop and maintain a robust sales pipeline aligned with annual growth targets.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive insights to regional and global stakeholders.


**Commercial Leadership \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and pricing strategies in collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Pricing, and Operations.
* Coordinate internal resources to ensure successful execution of customer projects and strategic initiatives.
* Support forecasting, strategic planning, enterprise account initiatives, and regional business reviews.
* Deliver annual sales, order intake, profitability, and customer satisfaction objectives.


**Customer Engagement \& Representation**
* Represent Kennametal at customer meetings, defence exhibitions, trade shows, and industry events.
* Coordinate customer visits, executive engagements, product presentations, and follow\-up activities.
* Promote Kennametal as a trusted strategic partner and solution provider within the defence market.


**Operational Excellence**
* Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and account plans.
* Complete required sales, compliance, export control, and corporate training.
* Effectively manage priorities and delegated tasks in a dynamic, customer\-focused environment.


**Experience And Education Requirements**
* Minimum 5 years of experience within the defence, industrial manufacturing, materials, or specialty applications industries.
* Experience managing complex multinational customer relationships, Key Account Management, Business Development, and/or Strategic Sales is highly desired.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Materials Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced Degrees are welcome but not required.
* Knowledge of defence applications including:
* Small, Medium and Large Calibre Weapons / Munitions
* Land Systems and Vehicle Protection
* Ability to obtain and maintain relevant security, export control, and customer\-specific clearances as required.


**Functional \& Technical Skills**
* High level of Autonomy and ability to work/organise self from a home office setting.
* Strong account management and business development capability.
* Excellent commercial acumen, including pricing, profitability, and financial analysis.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and influencing skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate market intelligence into actionable strategies.
* Proficient in CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Must be willing to Travel regularly withing EU and occasionally International.


**Language \& Communication Requirements**
* Fluent German (Native / C1 Level) – required for customer engagement, negotiations, and internal collaboration.
* Fluent English (C1 level) – required for international customers, global coordination, and reporting.

**Additional Information**
* This role is a Remote Contract primarily based in Germany
* Requires regular domestic and international travel.
* Drivers License required.
* The position supports strategic growth of Kennametal’s Defence and Specialty Applications portfolio in Europe and beyond.

Breyden ist ein führender Hersteller hochwertiger Brems\- und Antriebskomponenten mit einer langen industriellen Tradition und einem klaren Fokus auf Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit.
 



  





 Das Portfolio umfasst Guss\- und Präzisionsteile für die Automobilindustrie – von klassischen und beschichteten Bremsscheiben einschließlich Leichtbauvarianten über Bremssättel bis hin zu einbaufertigen Differenzialgetrieben.  Seit Anfang 2024 gehört Breyden zur AEQUITA\-Gruppe, einem langfristig orientierten, inhabergeführten Industrieinvestor mit zwölf Portfoliounternehmen und einem Gesamtumsatz von rund 10 Mrd. Euro. Im Jahr 2025 wurde Breyden um deutsche Standorte der MAT Foundry Group erweitert und beschäftigt seitdem an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland rund 1\.400 Mitarbeiter bei einer Produktionsleistung von 45 Millionen Gussteilen.
 



  





**Die Rolle** 




 Als Head of HR übernehmen Sie die strategische und operative Gesamtverantwortung für die Personalarbeit über alle Standorte. Sie berichten direkt an die Geschäftsführung und führen ein standortübergreifendes HR\-Team mit derzeit 13 Mitarbeitern disziplinarisch und fachlich.
 



 Ihre Aufgabe ist es, den begonnenen „One HR“\-Ansatz weiter umzusetzen und eine verlässliche, geschäftsnahe Personalarbeit sicherzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team entwickeln Sie die HR\-Organisation weiter und begleiten die organisatorischen, kulturellen und personellen Veränderungen bei Breyden.
 



  





**Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten** 



* Gesamtverantwortung für die HR\-Funktion sowie Beratung der Geschäftsführung und der Führungskräfte in strategischen, organisatorischen und personellen Fragestellungen

* Aktive Begleitung von Transformations\-, Integrations\- und Reorganisationsvorhaben einschließlich ihrer arbeitsrechtlichen Umsetzung
* Konstruktive und verbindliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Betriebsräten sowie Verhandlung und Umsetzung von Betriebsvereinbarungen
* Unterstützung der Führungskräfte bei der Weiterentwicklung einer unternehmerischen, verantwortungs\- und leistungsorientierten Führungskultur



  





**Das Profil** 



* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im operativen und strategischen Personalmanagement mit unmittelbarer HR\-Verantwortung für industrielle Produktionsstandorte ist Voraussetzung. Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung in der Automobilzulieferindustrie, der Metall\- oder Elektroindustrie oder einem vergleichbaren produzierenden Umfeld
* Sie kennen die Anforderungen gewerblich geprägter Belegschaften und des Schichtbetriebs aus eigener Praxis und arbeiten sicher mit Werkleitungen und Betriebsräten zusammen.
* Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung in einer HR\-Funktion, möglichst mit Verantwortung für mehrere Standorte
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und belastbare Verhandlungspraxis mit Betriebsräten; Tarif\- und Gewerkschaftserfahrung ist von Vorteil

* Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung von HR\-Strukturen und \-Prozessen sowie ein sicherer Blick für praktikable Lösungen

**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life \- enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life\-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100\+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.


Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end\-to\-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high\-quality, cost\-efficient clinical studies.


The role can be **home\-based, office\-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid**, and is offered as a **permanent full time (1 FTE) or part\-time position (0\.8 FTE / 80%)**.

**The CRA:**
------------

* Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
* Conducts remote or on\-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..
* Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH\-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well\-being and data reliability.
* Ensures audit readiness.
* Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.
* Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.
* Travel up to 50\-75%

**A day in the Life:**
----------------------

* Monitors investigator sites with a risk\-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
* Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on\-site and remote monitoring activities.
* Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
* Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
* Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
* May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
* Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
* Participates in the investigator payment process.
* Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
* Investigates and follows\-up on findings as applicable
* Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
* Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
* Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
* Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
* Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
* Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH\-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on\-site file reviews as per project specifications.
* Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
* Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
* Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
* Maintains \& completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
* Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
* Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role
* Valid driver's license
* Full Right to work in Germany
* **Fluency in English and German language to at least C1 level (note that the interview will be held in German).**

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**
--------------------------------

* Effective clinical monitoring skills
* Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
* Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
* Well\-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical attitude, in\-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and decision\-making
* Ability to handles Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
* Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
* Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
* Effective social skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Effective organizational and time management skills
* Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
* Ability to work in a team or independently as required
* Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
* Good presentation skills

*Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. / Schwerbehinderte Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt.*

js:https://de.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=5f88._text:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**Background**

As the lead United Nations agency on international development, UNDP works in 170 countries. For six decades, and in some 170 countries and territories, UNDP has shaped the progress of human development, providing integrated support at scale to improve lives for millions of people worldwide. UNDP’s Strategic Plan (2026\-2029\) helps countries and communities in their progress towards high human development while protecting the planet through four strategic objectives – prosperity for all, effective governance, crisis resilience, and healthy planet. The plan is powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation; gender equality; and sustainable finance. All are underpinned by a commitment to human rights and to leaving no one behind.


The Bureau for External Relations and Advocacy (BERA), leads and supports UNDP to build and deliver essential strategic relationships and alliances. It creates and delivers a strong public narrative about the organization, impact of our work, and how we align with partners to identify and build solutions towards achieving sustainable development. The Bureau also leads UNDP’s work with traditional donors, as well as building innovative and diversified funding relationships. BERA communications enable strong political and financial backing by providing partners and supporters with a clear understanding of what UNDP does and how our mission, capabilities and services reinforce global, regional, and national development priorities.


The New Strategic Partnerships Team within the Partnerships Group (Member States) of BERA, in collaboration with UNDP’s Global Policy Network (GPN), Bureau of Management (BMS), Regional Bureaux (RBx) and country offices, builds and manages strategic partnerships principally with Member States (non\-DAC), but also other partners in the Global South, with the aim of protecting and strengthening UNDP’s core and flexible resource base. The team provides political analysis and partner intelligence to position the organization and regularly advises its senior leadership and key partner governments. The team also builds networks and partnerships with a “whole of UNDP” approach to deepen partnerships and expand non\-core resources for the organization within the framework of the Corporate Resource Mobilization Strategy.


**Position Purpose**

Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Team Leader, New Strategic Partnerships, the Partnerships Specialist will support the implementation of UNDP’s New Strategic Partnerships (NSP) Strategy, including the implementation of work plans, strategic monitoring of targets, resource mobilization monitoring, communications, and knowledge management, among other areas. Implementation of the NSP Strategy will be carried out in close coordination with regional and global teams to align partners' interests with UNDP priorities. In his/her role, the Partnerships Specialist will work cross\-functionally with members of the Partnerships Group to facilitate and advance partnership opportunities and engagements that aim at strengthening relationship building, monitoring, reporting, intelligence gathering, visibility and communication, and knowledge management.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of the interconnected nature of development risks and crises that the world is facing and that call for assembling of multidisciplinary teams for an integrated and systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Partnership Development, Portfolio Management and Strategic Analysis**

* Provide substantive contributions to the design and implementation of partner engagement strategies and action plans, including definition of priorities, objectives, and KPIs across the assigned portfolio.
* Synthesize and analyze intelligence, including qualitative and quantitative data, to identify and assess trends, political and socio\-economic contexts, in support of ongoing and new partnership opportunities.
* Manage regular, proactive engagement with partners within the portfolio, providing analytical inputs and strategic advice to senior management and internal and external counterparts.
* Facilitate partner positioning by collaborating closely with the Communications Group and the Strategy, Projections, Analysis and Corporate Engagement (SPACE) team in BERA and other relevant units to shape outreach and visibility materials that reinforce UNDP’s mandate and value proposition.

**Support to Core and Non\-Core Resource Mobilization and Strategic Engagement**

* Facilitate the implementation of structured partner engagements, including preparation and follow\-up of Annual Consultations and other high\-level dialogues.
* Formulate analytical inputs on partners priorities, funding trends, and financing modalities to advise on strategic targeting and maximize resource mobilization opportunities.
* Monitor and evaluate core and non\-core resource mobilization trends, including the systematic monitoring and reporting of programme or project initiatives/opportunities in UNITY (Quantum \+) to facilitate informed decision\-making, reporting briefs/updates and general portfolio oversight.
* Catalyze the diversification efforts of non\-DAC partners in line with the Funding Windows Resource Mobilization strategy including preparations of new financing agreements.
* Serve as the BERA focal point to coordinate and manage knowledge, analytical tools, and technical guidance in support of government development financing (GDF) strategies and implementation.

**Coordination and Institutional Interface**

* Identify and coordinate the development and implementation of communications, advocacy and visibility initiatives/products in close coordination with the Communication Group, other teams in the Partnership Group and relevant Bureaux, ensuring strategic positioning and visibility of partners’ interests/priorities, contributions and results.
* Operationalize MOU and partnership framework processes, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and partner expectations.
* Provide technical inputs to funding analyses, partnership risk assessments, and the appraisal of emerging opportunities.
* Facilitate internal coordination across BERA teams, Regional Bureaux, and thematic units within Central Bureaux, including support to crisis response and time\-sensitive partner engagements.
* Promote and execute integrated ways of working within a distributed organizational model to ensure seamless delivery across global locations.

**Capacity building and knowledge\- sharing in partnerships building**

* Design and deliver partnership and resource mobilization capacity building materials and training with respect to specific portfolio of partners.
* Enhance UNDP’s partner knowledge repository through enhancements of relevant databases, resource mobilization toolkits, and other relevant tools for outreach for partner engagement.
* Codify and disseminate lessons learned from partner engagements to foster continuous improvement across teams and units.
* Provide strategic support for high\-level corporate events and initiatives as required.

Perform other duties within the incumbent’s functional profile as assigned by the direct supervisor, to support the efficient functioning of the office and the Organization.


Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: None


**Competencies**

* **Core Competencies:**

**Achieve Results:** LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact


**Think Innovatively:** LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems


**Learn Continuously:** LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences


**Adapt with Agility:** LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands


**Act with Determination:** LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results


**Engage and Partner:** LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration


**Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity


* **Cross\-Functional \& Technical competencies:**

**Business Direction \& Strategy\-System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system


**Business Management\-Portfolio Management:** Ability to select, prioritize and control the organization’s programmes and projects, in line with its strategic objectives and capacity; ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives and the maintenance of business\-as\-usual, while optimizing return on investment


**Business Management\-Communication:** Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels.


**Business Development\-Knowledge Facilitation:** Ability to animate individuals and groups , internally and externally, and to design and facilitate activities, to share and exchange knowledge, information and ideas. Knowledge of tools and approaches to stimulate active participation, contribution, and exchange.


**Partnership Management\-Multi\-stakeholder engagement and funding:** Knowledge and ability to forge multi\-stakeholder partnerships and remove any obstacles to resource mobilization and multi\-stakeholder funding platforms.


**Partnership Management\-Resource mobilization:** Ability to identify funding sources, match funding needs (programmes/projects/initiatives) with funding opportunities, and establish a plan to meet funding requirements


**Partnership Management\-Relationship management:** Ability to engage with a wide range of public and private partners, build, sustain and/or strengthen working relations, trust and mutual understanding  



**Required Skills and Experience**

Education:


* Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in International Development, International Affairs, Political Science, Public Policy or any related field is required, or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional 2 years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of master´s degree.

Experience:


* Minimum 5 years (with Master’s degree) or 7 years (with Bachelor’s degree) or relevant work experience in partnerships development, resource mobilization, development cooperation including South\-South and Triangular cooperation or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience supporting the development and management of strategic partnerships, including engagement with government counterparts, donors, or development partners and resource mobilization initiatives is required.
* Proven experience supporting and coordinating engagement with partners, advisory meetings, or complex multi\-stakeholder initiatives/meetings, including preparation of substantive background documentation is required.
* Experience working with or supporting initiatives with programme countries, emerging economies, G77 partners preferably from the Latin America region is desirable.
* Experience working directly with Government development financing (GDF) at country office or regional level is desired.
* Experience in providing strategic support for high\-level corporate events and initiatives is desired.
* Experience in knowledge management, including documenting good practices, lessons learned, and partnership case examples is desirable.
* Fluency in English is required;
* Working knowledge of another UN language (Spanish or French) is desired.

**Equal opportunity**

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.


UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.


**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.


**Probation**

For all new UNDP fixed term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter\-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.


**Right to select multiple candidates**

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.


**Use of AI by candidates**

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection


**Scam alert**

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam\-alert.


**Data Privacy**

Please click here to view UNDP Data Privacy Statement

**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**Background**

As the lead United Nations agency on international development, for six decades, UNDP works in some 170 countries and territories. UNDP has shaped the progress of human development, providing integrated support at scale to improve lives for millions of people worldwide. UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026\-2029 helps countries and communities in their progress towards high human development while protecting the planet through four strategic objectives – prosperity for all, effective governance, crisis resilience, and healthy planet. The plan is powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation; gender equality; and sustainable finance. All are underpinned by a commitment to human rights and to leaving no one behind.


The Bureau for Advocacy and External Relations leads and supports UNDP to build and deliver essential strategic relationships and alliances. It creates and delivers a strong public narrative about the organization, impact of our work, and how we align with partners to identify and build solutions towards achieving sustainable development. The Bureau also leads UNDP’s work with traditional donors, as well as building innovative and diversified funding relationships. BERA communications enable strong political and financial backing by providing partners and supporters with a clear understanding of what UNDP does and how our mission, capabilities and services reinforce global, regional, and national development priorities. BERA leads efforts to optimally position UNDP within the UN Development System, with Member States and in the inter\-governmental and inter\-agency fora. It identifies strategic opportunities to partner with agencies through multi\-stakeholder and bilateral platforms. It provides intelligence, advises on relationships with key political constituencies, incl. UN Member states, G77 and China, WEOG, EU, Executive Board and develops strategies. BERA coordinates and sets corporate standards across the functions of political positioning, partnerships, marketing and communications within UNDP and leads on internal communications.


The Brand and Marketing team develops and promotes UNDP’s global brand. It leads marketing initiatives, campaigns and flagship products; provides advice and services across the organization; supports brand consistency and capacity; and manages platforms including the Marketing Services Hub and UNDP Shop.


**Position Purpose**

Under the guidance of the Team Leader of the Brand and Marketing team, the Creative Lead and Copywriter provides creative oversight of UNDP’s corporate brand and marketing initiatives, leading the development and execution of integrated creative concepts across copy, design and other visual content. The role combines hands\-on copywriting with responsibility for guiding designers and other creatives, ensuring outputs are audience\-centric and coherent.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of interconnected nature of development risks \& crises that the world is facing and that call for assembling of multidisciplinary teams for an integrated \& systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration


**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Creative leadership and quality oversight**

* Provide creative oversight for UNDP’s global brand and marketing outputs ensuring all marketing, communications and advocacy materials consistently reflect the organization's values, identity and positioning.
* Ensure consistency, audience relevance and creative excellence across all copy, design and visual content, in alignment with UNDP's brand standards and communications objectives.
* Support the implementation of brand guidelines and contribute to maintaining brand integrity across digital and print channels.
* Collaborate with designers, content creators and communications colleagues to produce engaging and impactful content.
* Collaborate with communications, marketing, partnerships and programme teams to ensure creative outputs effectively support organizational priorities and strategic objectives.
* Monitor brand performance and audience response, using insights and analytics to continuously improve creative effectiveness and impact.

**Lead integrated marketing campaigns and flagship products**

* Conceptualize, develop and lead integrated marketing campaigns and creative products that increase the reach, understanding and engagement of UNDP’s priority audiences.
* Design creative campaign strategies that combine storytelling, content marketing, digital engagement, social media, partnerships, events and paid media approaches.
* Lead campaign planning processes, including audience segmentation, messaging architecture, creative development, content production, launch planning and performance measurement.
* Oversee the development of flagship communications and marketing products, ensuring they are audience\-centered, innovative and aligned with UNDP's global brand positioning.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, regional and country offices, external agencies and production partners to ensure cohesive and effective campaign execution.
* Establish campaign objectives, key performance indicators and evaluation frameworks, analyzing results and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Identify opportunities to expand campaign reach, strengthen public engagement and increase awareness of UNDP's impact and initiatives.

**Lead in** **creative copywriting and content**

* Develop compelling, audience\-focused copy and messaging for UNDP’s corporate marketing campaigns, platforms and products.
* Create compelling, audience\-centered copy for digital platforms, social media, websites, email campaigns, publications, marketing materials and branded products.
* Translate complex development topics into clear, engaging and accessible content for diverse audiences.
* Edit and proofread communications products to ensure clarity, consistency, accuracy and adherence to UNDP style standards.
* Collaborate with designers and multimedia specialists to produce integrated content and storytelling products.
* Adapt content for different platforms and audience segments while maintaining a consistent brand voice.
* Stay informed of emerging creative, marketing and digital communication trends and incorporate relevant best practices into content development.

**Coordinate creative production and project delivery**

* Coordinate the development and delivery of high\-quality creative products, working across multidisciplinary teams and managing multiple assignments and deadlines.
* Stay informed of emerging creative, marketing and digital communication trends and incorporate relevant best practices into content development.
* Manage creative briefs, stakeholder consultations, approvals and production workflows to ensure efficient project execution.
* Monitor multiple assignments simultaneously and prioritize workloads to meet deadlines.
* Identify and address production challenges in a proactive and solutions\-oriented manner.
* Anticipate and mitigate potential project risks, bottlenecks and resource constraints while maintaining delivery schedules.
* Oversee procurement processes related to creative services and production vendors, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
* Maintain effective collaboration and communication among project stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.
* Track project performance and outcomes, preparing reports and recommendations for continuous improvement.

**Promote** **E\-commerce marketing and product development and facilitate knowledge management**

* Advice and support the growth and positioning of UNDP’s e\-commerce platform through marketing, creative content and the development of brand\-aligned products.
* Identify, synthesize and document best practices and lessons learned that are generated from the project and implementing partners.
* Assist in identifying opportunities for new products and creative approaches that strengthen brand visibility and audience engagement.
* Contribute to the development of marketing materials that effectively showcase UNDP\-branded products and merchandise.
* Collect, organize and maintain information, resources and examples of successful campaigns, products and creative initiatives.
* Identify, document and share lessons learned, best practices and innovative approaches emerging from projects and partnerships.
* Support knowledge\-sharing activities and contribute to continuous improvement of creative and marketing practices across the organization.
* Increased visibility and engagement for UNDP’s e\-commerce activities and branded products.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.


Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: None


**Competencies**

* **Core Competencies:**

**Achieve Results:** LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact


**Think Innovatively:** LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems


**Learn Continuously:** LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences


**Adapt with Agility:** LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands


**Act with Determination:** LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results


**Engage and Partner:** LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration


**Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity


* **Cross\-Functional \& Technical competencies:**

**Business Direction \& Strategy\-System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system


**Business Management\-Portfolio Management:** Ability to select, prioritize and control the organization’s programmes and projects, in line with its strategic objectives and capacity; ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives and the maintenance of business\-as\-usual, while optimizing return on investment


**Digital and Innovation\-Design thinking:** Solving problems by putting people at the centre, visualising ideas and making them tangible in order to improve them through and iterative process of developing and testing. Strong empathy skills, being able to put yourself ""in someone else's shoes”, understand needs, abilities, preferences, motivations, (everyday) experiences from different perspectives as well as their cultural, social, economical and political contexts. Ability to identify and challenge assumptions, (cognitive and social) biases and dominant mental models by generating new perspectives and frames that help redefine the problem, solution and opportunity space. Being able to work with incomplete information, ambiguity and opposing views, needs and constraints and synthesise them into solutions that are viable, technically feasible and useful


**Communications\-Marketing:** Ability to communicate the value of a product or service


**Communications\-Campaign management:** Ability to produce and implement communications and advocacy campaigns that lead to impactful change


**Communications\-Creative direction and copywriting:** Ability to creatively communicate concepts in an engaging and simple way


**Communications\-Brand and quality management:** Ability to position the UNDP brand and uphold it to a high level of quality


**Required Skills and Experience**

Education:


* Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Copywriting, Journalism, Design or a related field is required. Or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:


* A minimum of five (5\) years (with a master’s degree), or seven (7\) years (with a bachelor’s degree), of relevant professional experience in communications, marketing, advertising, creative direction, copywriting, strategic outreach or a related field is required.
* At least three years of experience providing creative direction for integrated marketing and/or advertising work, including oversight of both copy and design, is required.
* Demonstrated experience in creative copywriting and translating ideas into integrated marketing or advertising products, supported by a portfolio demonstrating both copywriting and creative direction, is required.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver high\-quality creative products under tight deadlines is required.
* A strong understanding of design principles and demonstrated ability to provide clear, actionable creative directions to designers is required.
* Strong project\-management skills and experience coordinating multiple creative projects, contributors and stakeholders are required.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications is required.
* Familiarity with the Sustainable Development Goals and international development issues is required.
* Experience optimizing content for search\-engine marketing desired.
* Previous professional experience within the United Nations system or a comparable international organization is an asset.
* Professional experience in an advertising, branding or creative agency environment is desirable.
* Experience developing creative work for B2B, nonprofit or purpose\-driven marketing initiatives, is desirable.
* Experience pitching and presenting creative concepts to senior clients or decision\-makers is desirable.
* Experience managing creative projects and campaigns across multiple countries, regions or culturally diverse audiences is desirable.
* Demonstrated experience using digital storytelling, social media and audience engagement is desirable.
* Experience working with multiple creative stakeholders is desirable.
* Fluency in English, with exceptional writing and copywriting skills, is required.
* Working knowledge of another United Nations language is desirable.

**Equal opportunity**

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.


UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.


**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.


**Probation**

For all new UNDP fixed term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter\-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.


**Right to select multiple candidates**

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.


**Use of AI by candidates**

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

**Call for Applications**
  

  

DFG\-Research Training Group (RTG)
  

  

**„Urban Future – managing transformations for a better health in blue cities“**

  

  

**10 doctoral research positions (all genders)** 

**in the interdisciplinary field of urban health**
=====================================================================================================


The Research Training Group will start on 1 April 2027\. Successful applicants will be offered a 4\-year doctoral support contract with remuneration dependent on TV\-L pay grade 13 (65%) according to the German public salary scale; employment will be either at the University of Bonn or the Bonn\-Rhein\-Sieg University of Applied Sciences. Degrees will be obtained from the medical, mathematical\-natural science, philosophical or agricultural, nutritional and engineering sciences faculties or the Promotionskolleg NRW, respectively, depending on disciplinary background and research focus. All doctoral researchers will complete the structured doctoral program, which strongly emphasizes systems thinking and transdisciplinary approaches to build meta\-competencies for urban health research. Next to overarching interdisciplinary courses, specific disciplinary courses and soft\-skills training make up the foundation of the program.
The RTG „Urban Future“ investigates how urban transformations in “Blue Cities“ – urban areas situated along rivers or coastlines where water is explicitly integrated into urban planning and holds a central place in societal identity – can be managed to improve public health, social equity, and ecological sustainability. The research focuses on the complex water\-health\-governance nexus, with a particular emphasis on cities in the Global South as living laboratories. The RTG is a joint initiative of the University of Bonn and the Bonn\-Rhein\-Sieg University of Applied Sciences, in close cooperation with international partner institutions in Ghana (KNUST, UG, UCC), Togo (UOL), Cameroon (UBUEA), Brazil (USP) and Japan (UTokyo). While partner networks provide a strong international framework, applicants are free to propose research sites in any “Blue City” worldwide.
The RTG is structured around **four overarching Research Themes (RTs):*** A) Urban Health Resilience,
* B) Urban Disease Ecology,
* C) Governance and Institutional Change, and
* D) Adaptive Urban Ecosystems

**Your tasks:**
* Actively participate in the RTG training program and interdisciplinary seminars
* Conduct independent, RT\-aligned doctoral research, including method development, data collection, analysis, and publication
* Contribute to the development of Blue City concepts and transdisciplinary knowledge exchange

**Your profile:**
* Completed Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline (e.g., Agricultural and Food Systems, Climate and Earth Sciences, Development Studies, Ecology and Life Sciences, Economics and Management, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Environmental and Health Sciences, Geography, Infectious Diseases, Hygiene/infection control, (Medical) Microbiology, Public Health, Urban and Regional Studies, and Social Sciences)
* Strong interdisciplinary mindset and clear interest in urban transformations, water\-health nexus, or urban health
* Excellent written and oral English language skills

**What we offer:**
* A stimulating, international, and interdisciplinary doctoral environment with strong national and global research networks
* Structured supervision, clear progression criteria, and dedicated career development support
* Full funding for fieldwork, travel, and related research expenses
* Comprehensive training in systems thinking, transdisciplinary methods, and academic communication
* Committed to diversity and equal opportunity; certified as a family\-friendly university

**Application process \& documents**
The selection process is two\-stage. Applications will be evaluated by the RTG Selection Committee, and only the most qualified candidates will be invited to a virtual interview.
* Curriculum vitae (tabular format)
* Higher education degree certificate(s) and full transcript(s) of records, including an explanation of the grading system of all previous studies
* Motivation letter (max. 500 words)
* Research exposé (max. 1500 words)
* Interdisciplinary research statement (max. 500 words)
* Two letters of recommendation
* English language proficiency certification (B2 level (CEFR, TOEFL or equivalent))

In accordance with the (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz (LGG) NRW), women will be given preference in cases of equal suitability, qualifications and professional performance, unless reasons relating to another candidate prevail. Join the Canyon team and work at the cutting edge of the bike industry, with a job as versatile and exciting as the bikes we develop. All in an open, international atmosphere where teamwork, collaboration, true innovation, and a dynamic workplace are all part of our everyday. Ready to ride with us?


Stellenbeschreibung
**THE ROLE**
------------

  

Data is at the heart of how we grow, optimize, and innovate our e\-commerce business at Canyon. As a (Senior) Data Engineer in our Digital department, you lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable automated data ingestion pipelines, including technical governance and architecture ownership. You bring our commercial, CRM, and marketing data into Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) to establish Canyon’s data warehouse for advanced analytics, data science, and AI applications.


**YOUR JOB AS PART OF THE CANYON CREW**
---------------------------------------

  

* **Pipeline Engineering \& Integration:** Building resilient pipelines ingests high\-volume e\-commerce data from enterprise systems (SAP ERP/Datasphere, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Service Cloud) and digital marketing channels (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, web events) into BigQuery.
* **Technical Governance:** Defining data ingestion standards, source\-to\-target mappings, pipeline SLAs, access management (IAM), and security controls ensures robust system integrity.
* **Cloud Architecture \& Infrastructure:** Designing, deploying, and maintaining Canyon’s GCP data warehouse environment (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Workflows, Pub/Sub, dbt, external APIs) optimizes overall data flow.
* **Data Reliability:** Overseeing data quality, observability, error handling, and troubleshooting frameworks (monitoring, logging, alerting, fixing) guarantees high data availability for downstream applications.
* **Software Engineering Excellence:** Implementing software engineering best practices within the data team establishes version control (Git), automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated pipeline testing.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partnering closely with IT system engineers maintains data consistency with source systems while providing hands\-on support to data analyst:s and data scientist:s in downstream data transformation.
* **Discoverability:** Ensuring transparency and accessibility of pipelines and solutions for the wider data team is achieved through comprehensive in\-system and external documentation.
**HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE RACE**
-----------------------------------

  

* **Educational Background:** A degree in data engineering, computer science, business informatics, or a closely related field forms the foundation of your expertise.

------------

  

Data is at the heart of how we grow, optimize, and innovate our e\-commerce business at Canyon. * **Customer Intelligence:** Designing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models that integrate customer, transaction, engagement data, and acquisition costs leverages complex enterprise data structures.

* **Acquisition Channel Optimization:** Defining and deploying an advanced Marketing Mix Model (MMM) through Google’s Meridian framework measures and optimizes multi\-channel advertising efficiency.
* **Personalization Engine:** Developing personalization systems for website and marketing touchpoints utilizes customer engagement and preference data.
* **Predictive Marketing:** Implementing propensity\-to\-buy and propensity\-to\-churn models fuels targeted email remarketing as well as predictive lookalike audiences across paid media channels.

Wir suchen zum **1\. Januar 2027** für den Standort **Köln** in der **Abteilung Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation,** eine\*n **Wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in (Doktorand\*in) im Bereich Geodatenmanagement**

**(Entgeltgruppe 13 TV\-L, 75 % Arbeitszeit, befristet auf 3 Jahre)**


Die Abteilung „**Survey Data Curation**“ bereitet sozialwissenschaftliche Forschungsdaten fast aller Art für Sekundärnutzungen auf, um die soziologische und politikwissenschaftliche Forschung besonders im Hinblick auf räumlich und zeitlich vergleichende Analysen zu unterstützen. Darunter sind lang\-laufende nationale (z.B. ALLBUS, GLES) und internationale (z.B. ISSP, CSES) Umfrageprogramme, die besonders sorgfältig dokumentiert werden. Ein Schwerpunkt der Arbeiten ist die Erstellung von Trendfiles und die Verknüpfung mit Kontext\- und Geodaten. „Electoral Spaces“ ist ein Projekt unseres Teams „Survey Data Augmentation“, das eine Forschungsdateninfrastruktur entwickelt, um geokodierte Wahldaten besser auffindbar, zugänglicher, interoperabel und wiederverwendbar zu machen.

**Ihr Aufgabengebiet:**
-----------------------

* Einrichtung der Datenspeichertechnologie und Programmierung der R\-Schnittstelle sowie der Hilfstools für „Electoral Spaces“
* Testen und Bewerten des Tech\-Stacks, um sicherzustellen, dass er den Anforderungen der Forschenden an räumliche Wahldaten entspricht
* Unterstützung bei der Datenmodellierung, den Pipelines zur Datenerfassung und den Kuratierungs\-Workflows
* Mitwirkung an der technischen Dokumentation, der Öffentlichkeitsarbeit für das Projekt und der Verbreitung der Ergebnisse
* Durchführung methodischer oder angewandter Forschung, um den Mehrwert der Infrastruktur aufzuzeigen
**Ihr Profil:**
---------------

* Master\-Abschluss in Geografie, Geoinformatik, räumlicher Datenwissenschaft oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
* Technisches Verständnis für Geodaten\-Software\-Stacks und fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in R
* Starkes Interesse an der Anwendung von GIS und räumlichen Daten in der politik\- und sozialwissenschaftlichen Forschung
* Motivation, eine Doktorarbeit zu verfassen, die eng mit dem Projekt verknüpft ist
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
**Wir bieten:**
---------------

* Die Möglichkeit, einen Beitrag zu einer Forschungsdateninfrastruktur zu leisten, die erheblichen Einfluss auf die Zukunft der Demokratieforschung haben soll
* Arbeit in einem integrierten aber flexiblen Team von quantitativen Sozialwissenschaftler\*innen mit Synergien zwischen Projekten zur Anreicherung von Umfragedaten, spezialisiert auf Geodaten und Demokratie
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Regelungen zum mobilen Arbeiten
* Sehr gute Bedingungen für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie u.a. durch Zuschüsse zur Betreuung von nicht schulpflichtigen Kindern

* Förderung Ihrer Kompetenzen durch Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen
